notes.title: Zone B Korosu 1-Year Anniversary Update!
notes.content:
To celebrate our first year live, we've added some new graphical updates, a new arcade stage, some bugfixes, and a few new surprise features!

Thanks to everyone along for the ride, and look forward to a [i]huge [/i] Summer update in the coming months.

notes.title: Winter Update pt 1
notes.content:
2022 Winter Update pt. 1

- fixed an issue which had significantly increased load times
- full controller support for cutscenes and menus (clickable background objects still need to be clicked for now)
- added 'advance cam' and 'reverse cam' buttons for easy navigation
- updated various bossfight characteristics
- streamlined dialogue system; now players can double-click 'submit' button to see all of any text box
- locked down aspect ratio to 16:10 and 16:9 to minimize scaling issues
- various graphical updates

notes.title: Summer Update!
notes.content:
- graphical and audio updates

- Arcade Mode and Arcade Stage 1 now accessible upon completion of Story Mode

- enemies now have a chance to drop quarters, which can be used in the arcade

- added quarter inventory system

- updated interactible objects in level 1-6

notes.title: 1-Month Update Patch: 1.01
notes.content:
